thesis: The page is a bound test report on four sidings: every section is a numbered report page, and every claim is a reading on a five-cell bar that fills when you reach it, so the homeowner reads the result before the pitch.

signature.name: Five-Cell Reading
signature.summary: A row of five square outlined cells that fill in ultramarine beside a monospace reading, always under a hairline report header row (TEST 03, FIBER CEMENT, COLD AND MOISTURE). Material scores in the hero cover strip and compare table, a scope scale on service results, the squares count in the calculator, star cells on field-note reviews, a shared price ruler on the price sheet, every cell filled at the footer sign-off.

palette.family: Report Bond + Graphite + Result Ultramarine + Highlighter

layoutMoves: ruled 12-col report grid with a visible left margin column carrying page and test numbers
report cover hero: h1 left 7 cols, specimen-plate photo right 5 cols with a mono dimension line, 4-line cover strip across the base
compare table as the spine of the page: sticky material column, criteria rows, scroll-snap on mobile
price sheet set as a tabular mono ledger with range bars on one shared scale

motion.intro: cover strip header rows wipe in left to right (60ms stagger), then each bar fills cell by cell, under 1.0s, skippable
stories: fill: compare rows fill their five cells as each row enters
stack: four method report pages stack and lift like clipboard sheets, pinned at 900px and up
motion.hover: 1.5px ultramarine hairline grows under the item, scaleX 0 to 1 from the left, 200ms
